summary: Tested the 4 shipped changes end-to-end on https://foundation-site-12.preview.emergentagent.com. Verified Results page (header/sub/desc, 4 graduates with images loaded naturalWidth>0, 4 scholars with YEAR 1/3/6/8 labels, CTA band buttons -> /partner and /csr-partners), Our Story page (14-photo collage, 3 paragraphs, new Community Centers section w/ Kolkata+Pune), Donate header area + donate-csr-link -> /csr-partners, small-gift simulated flow (success 'Thank you. Truly.'), Priority Giving flow (>=1,00,000 threshold notice + 'Talk to Our Giving Desk' button, priority-giving-box with exact headline, giving-desk-back-btn returns to amount step, submit yields 'Conversation started.' with POST /api/submissions 200), CSR qualify regression, Footer socials (4 correct hrefs with target=_blank), 4 trust/certification labels, 7 menu links, disclaimer, nav spot-check. Mobile 375px — graduates stack 2-col, scholars 2-col. No console errors on /transformations, /about, /partner. Backend /api/submissions verified via curl (HTTP 200, {ok:true}).
critical_code_review_comments: Footer.jsx testid generation used /[^a-z]+/g which stripped digits and apostrophes, producing wrong testids (footer-cert--g-certified, footer-cert-sec-compliance, footer-link-let-s-talk) that didn't match the spec. Fixed by changing the regex to strip apostrophes then collapse non [a-z0-9] runs to '-' and trim leading/trailing hyphens. Now produces footer-cert-80g-certified, footer-cert-sec-135-compliance, footer-link-lets-talk as required.
Partner.jsx is 643 lines and would benefit from being split into step components (StepType/Amount/Payment/Qualify/GivingDesk/Success) in separate files for maintainability.
Transformations graduate images 3 & 4 are curated Unsplash stock photos — EXPECTED per spec until real graduate photos are provided.
seed_data_creation: Created test POST /api/submissions records with TEST_ prefixed names (TEST_SmallGift donation, TEST_Priority hni giving-desk, TEST_CSR csr). Also a curl POST during backend sanity.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Footer testid regex was fixed to support digits and apostrophes correctly. All 4 priority flows pass. Donations remain simulated (no Razorpay keys). When adding new footer MENU/CERTIFICATIONS entries, the testid will be auto-generated via the fixed regex.
rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE: In /app/frontend/src/components/Footer.jsx, both the MENU and CERTIFICATIONS maps generated data-testid via `label.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z]+/g, '-')`. Because the character class only kept lowercase a-z, digits (80, 135) and apostrophes were replaced by '-', producing testids that did not match the spec. REPRO: Load /about, inspect footer DOM — testids were footer-cert--g-certified, footer-cert-sec-compliance, footer-link-let-s-talk. FIX: replaced with `label.toLowerCase().replace(/'/g, '').replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-|-$/g, '')` — strips apostrophes, keeps digits, collapses non-alphanumeric to single '-', trims boundary hyphens. VERIFIED: expected testids now present.
